## Problem or use case

What are you trying to do, and what prevents it today?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful change, with an example of the intended API or workflow
when applicable.

## Alternatives and evidence

Can an existing API or simpler approach solve the problem? For statistical-method changes,
link relevant primary sources and describe how the change could be validated.
